# dedalus_machine (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dedalus_machine" "example_machine" {
  autosleep = "autosleep"
  image_id = "image_id"
  memory_mib = 1
  storage_gib = 1
  vcpu = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `autosleep` (String) Idle window before autosleep. Accepts fixed duration units like 30s, 30m, 2h, 7d3h4s, or 1w3d, raw seconds ("1800"), or never to disable.
- `image_id` (String) Organization-owned ready custom image ID. Requires Pro. Omit for the platform default.
- `memory_mib` (Number) Memory in MiB.
- `storage_gib` (Number) Storage in GiB.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `vcpu` (Number) CPU in vCPUs.

### Read-Only

- `autosleep_seconds` (Number) Seconds of inactivity before autosleep. 0 disables autosleep.
- `desired_state` (String) Available values: "running", "sleeping", "destroyed".
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `machine_id` (String)
- `phase` (String) Available values: "accepted", "placement_pending", "starting", "running", "stopping", "sleeping", "destroying", "destroyed", "failed".
- `status` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status))

- `update` (String) The timeout for the operation, default: 600 seconds

<a id="nestedatt--status--autoresize--cpu"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status.autoresize.cpu`

Read-Only:

- `blocked_at` (String) Time the current refusal was first recorded.
- `blocked_reason` (String) Why the latest automatic increase could not proceed, as the error code an explicit resize would return. Absent once an automatic increase is accepted.
Available values: "MACHINE_GROWTH_LIMIT_REACHED", "MACHINE_TIER_SHAPE_EXCEEDED", "MACHINE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED", "MACHINE_MEMORY_ABOVE_LIMIT", "ASSIGNED_HOST_CAPACITY_CONFLICT", "MACHINE_PLACEMENT_EXHAUSTED", "MACHINE_RESIZE_UNAVAILABLE", "MACHINE_SHAPE_UNSUPPORTED".

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import dedalus_machine.example '<machine_id>'
```
